p-section.p-paragraph: RetroGo is a high-performance retro game emulator frontend for iPhone and iPad, built on the RetroArch/Libretro framework. It combines native UIKit interfaces, SpriteKit touch controls, save states, controller support, game discovery, and a powerful file-based library into a focused iOS experience.

RetroGo believes in the power of the open-source community. This project is open-sourced under the GNU GPLv3 license. You can access our GitHub repository to obtain the source code, contribute to the project, or submit feedback: https://github.com/askrsw/RetroGo-iOS.

This application integrates multiple Libretro cores. Each core independently follows its original open-source license, including GPL, LGPL, MIT, BSD, and other compatible licenses. For a detailed list of cores and their corresponding license texts, please refer to the "Core List" page within the app.

RetroGo is designed for users who manage their own legally obtained game files. Imported games, save states, screenshots, metadata, settings, and controller mappings are stored locally on your device.
By using this app, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
RetroGo is provided only as a general-purpose emulator frontend. We do not bundle, provide, or distribute commercial game images (ROMs) or system firmware (BIOS).

Users are responsible for ensuring that the content they load is legally authorized and complies with local laws and regulations. RetroGo is not affiliated with any game console manufacturer, platform owner, publisher, developer, or trademark holder.
Sincere thanks to the RetroArch/Libretro team, open-source contributors, and homebrew game creators whose work helped make RetroGo possible.
